PAYMENT_FAILED.subject: Payment failed
PAYMENT_FAILED.body: Your payment{amount}{forEvent}{when} did not go through. We did not issue any tickets.{reason}{retry} If your bank shows a charge for this attempt, it will be reversed automatically.

paymentFailureReason.INTERNATIONAL_CARD_NOT_ACCEPTED: The card was issued outside India, and international cards are not accepted for this payment. Use a card issued in India or another payment method.
paymentFailureReason.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: There were not enough funds available.
paymentFailureReason.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: The OTP or card verification step was not completed.
paymentFailureReason.CANCELLED: The payment was cancelled before it completed.
paymentFailureReason.TIMED_OUT: The payment timed out before your bank confirmed it.
paymentFailureReason.BANK_UNAVAILABLE: Your bank or the payment network was not responding.
paymentFailureReason.METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE: That payment method is not available for this booking.

EVENT_REMINDER.subject: Reminder: your event is coming up

SHOW_CANCELLED.subject: Your show has been cancelled
SHOW_CANCELLED.body: We are sorry - {event} has been cancelled. Your booking {reference} is no longer valid{when}. A refund will follow.
SHOW_CANCELLED.bodyFree: We are sorry - {event} has been cancelled. Your booking {reference} is no longer valid{when}. The booking was free, so no money was taken and there is nothing to refund.
SHOW_CANCELLED.bodyCash: We are sorry - {event} has been cancelled. Your booking {reference} is no longer valid{when}. You paid {amount} in cash at the counter. The box office at the venue will give you back {amount} in cash. Show your booking reference {reference} at the box office.
SHOW_CANCELLED.subjectOrganizerCash: Show cancelled: cash to give back
SHOW_CANCELLED.bodyOrganizerCash: {event}{when} has been cancelled. Booking {reference} for {buyer} was paid in cash at the counter. The buyer gave no email, so this message comes to you. Give {amount} in cash back to {buyer} at the counter. Then open Counter and select Mark as given back.

SHOW_CHANGED.subject: Your show has been rescheduled
SHOW_CHANGED.body: The time of {event} has changed. Your booking {reference} is still valid{when}.

BOOKING_CANCELLED.subject: Your booking was cancelled
BOOKING_CANCELLED.body: Your booking {reference}{forEvent}{when} has been cancelled. Its tickets no longer work.{refund}

REFUND_COMPLETED.subject: Your refund is complete
REFUND_COMPLETED.body: A refund of {amount} for booking {reference} has been completed. It usually reaches your account within a few working days.
REFUND_COMPLETED.subjectProcessing: Your refund has been sent to your bank
REFUND_COMPLETED.bodyProcessing: We have sent a refund of {amount} for booking {reference}. Your bank is now processing it. It usually reaches your account within 5 to 7 working days.

REFUND_REQUESTED.subject: A refund was requested for your booking
REFUND_REQUESTED.subjectShowCancelled: Your show was cancelled: a refund is open
REFUND_REQUESTED.body: A refund of {amount} was requested for booking {reference}. Nothing has been decided yet and no money has moved - the organizer reviews the request and you will be told the outcome. If you did not ask for this, contact the organizer before it is approved: whoever has the link to your tickets was able to make this request.
REFUND_REQUESTED.bodyShowCancelled: Your show was cancelled, so a refund of {amount} has been opened for booking {reference}. You do not need to do anything. The organizer approves it, and you will be told when the money is on its way.

ATTENDEE_INVITED.subject: You've been given a ticket
ATTENDEE_INVITED.body: You have been invited to claim a ticket{ref}. Open the link to accept it into your wallet.

ATTENDEE_ACCEPTED.subject: Your ticket was claimed
ATTENDEE_ACCEPTED.body: {attendee} has accepted the ticket you shared.

ATTENDEE_DECLINED.subject: A ticket invitation was declined
ATTENDEE_DECLINED.body: An invitation for ticket {ticketId} was declined; the ticket is yours to reassign.

TICKET_TRANSFERRED.subject: Ticket transferred
TICKET_TRANSFERRED.body: Ticket {ticketId} has been transferred to a new holder.

SHARE_CREATED.subject: Someone shared an experience with you
SHARE_CREATED.body: You've been sent {permission} access. Open the link to view it: {url}

SHARE_VIEWED.subject: Your shared link was opened
SHARE_VIEWED.body: A share link for ticket {ticketId} was just opened.

SHARE_REVOKED.subject: Share access revoked
SHARE_REVOKED.body: Access to ticket {ticketId} has been revoked.

ORGANIZATION_REGISTERED.subject: New organizers awaiting approval
ORGANIZATION_REGISTERED.body: {organization} has registered and is waiting for review. Contact: {contact}. Open the review queue to see everyone who is waiting. We send at most one of these emails an hour. An organizer cannot sell tickets until an admin approves them.

ORGANIZATION_APPROVED.subject: {organization} is approved
ORGANIZATION_APPROVED.body: {organization} has been approved and can now sell tickets. Open the organizer console to add your venues and events.

ORGANIZATION_REJECTED.subject: {organization} was not approved
ORGANIZATION_REJECTED.body: {organization} has not been approved.{reason} Contact support if you would like to discuss it.

EVENT_SUBMITTED.subject: Event awaiting review: {event}
EVENT_SUBMITTED.body: {organization} submitted '{event}' for review. It cannot go on sale until an admin approves it.

EVENT_APPROVED.subject: '{event}' is approved
EVENT_APPROVED.body: '{event}' has been approved and is now published.

EVENT_REJECTED.subject: '{event}' needs changes
EVENT_REJECTED.body: '{event}' was not approved.{reason} Make the changes and submit it again.

EVENT_NOT_SELLABLE.subject: '{event}' is live but cannot be sold
EVENT_NOT_SELLABLE.body: Customers can find '{event}' and are turned away at checkout. {reason} Open the event in your organizer console to fix it.

EVENT_PAUSED_BY_ADMIN.subject: ETicketsGo paused sales for '{event}'
EVENT_PAUSED_BY_ADMIN.body: ETicketsGo paused '{event}', so tickets are not on sale.{reason} Tickets already sold stay valid. Fix what the reason names, then write to ETicketsGo support from Help & support in your organizer console and ask for sales to start again. Only ETicketsGo can lift this pause.

EVENT_RESUMED_BY_ADMIN.subject: '{event}' is on sale again
EVENT_RESUMED_BY_ADMIN.body: ETicketsGo lifted the pause on '{event}'. Tickets are on sale again.

SUPPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED.subject: New {kind} message [{reference}]: {topic}
SUPPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED.lead: A message came in through a support form.
SUPPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED.replyHint: Reply to this email to answer the sender. Your reply goes to {email}.
SUPPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED.noReplyAddress: The sender gave no email address, so a reply to this email will not reach them.
SUPPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED.truncated: This message was shortened for email. Read all of it in the admin console.
SUPPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED.adminLink: Open it in the admin console: {link}

SUPPORT_REQUEST_ACKNOWLEDGED.subject: We have your message [{reference}]
SUPPORT_REQUEST_ACKNOWLEDGED.body: Thank you for writing to ETicketsGo. We have your message and we will reply to {email}. Your reference is {reference}. If you write to us again about this, please give this reference.

PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_AWAITING_VERIFICATION.subject: Bank account waiting for verification: {organization}
PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_AWAITING_VERIFICATION.body: {organization} saved a {currency} payout bank account at {bank}, ending {last4} (version {version}). Changed: {changes}. Entered by {savedBy}. No payout can go to it until it is verified. A staff member other than the person who entered these details must verify them: {savedBy} cannot, and nor can anyone who belongs to {organization}. Open Payouts > Bank accounts in the admin console to check it.

saved.subject: Your {currency} payout bank account was changed
saved.body: The {currency} payout bank account was saved as {bank}, ending {last4} (version {version}). Changed: {changes}. It shows as waiting for verification until ETicketsGo staff check it. If this was not you, contact support now and change your password.

verified.subject: Your {currency} payout bank account was verified
verified.body: ETicketsGo staff verified the {currency} payout bank account at {bank}, ending {last4} (version {version}). If you did not expect this, contact support now.

rejected.subject: Your {currency} payout bank account was not accepted
rejected.body: ETicketsGo staff could not verify the {currency} payout bank account at {bank}, ending {last4} (version {version}).{reason} Check the details and save the account again.

fragments.heldUntil: Your seats are held until {time}. Go back to the payment page before then to try again with another card or payment method.
fragments.retryLater: You can start a new booking at any time.
fragments.accessLink: Open your tickets here, no account needed: {link}
fragments.nothingToRefund: The booking was free, so no money was taken and there is nothing to refund.
fragments.accountTicketsLink: See your tickets in your account: {link}

GUEST_BOOKING_ACCESS.subject: Your ETicketsGo tickets
GUEST_BOOKING_ACCESS.body: Open this link to see your booking and your tickets: {link}. It is the newest link for this booking, so any earlier one has stopped working. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message - nothing about your booking has changed.

PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED.subject: Reset your ETicketsGo password
PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED.body: Open this link to choose a new password: {link}. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message - your password has not changed.

EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE.subject: Your ETicketsGo email code
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE.body: Your code is {code}. Type it on ETicketsGo to add this email address to your account. It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message - nothing has changed.
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE.confirmBody: Your code is {code}. Type it on ETicketsGo to confirm that this email address is yours. It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message - nothing has changed.

TEAM_INVITATION.subject: You are invited to join {organizationName} on ETicketsGo
TEAM_INVITATION.body: {inviterName} invited you to join {organizationName} on ETicketsGo as {role}. To accept, open this link and sign in with this email address: {link}. The link works once and expires in {days} days. Only you can accept it. If you did not expect this, ignore this message - nothing changes.

PASSWORD_CHANGED.subject: Your ETicketsGo password was changed
PASSWORD_CHANGED.body: Your password was just changed and you have been signed out everywhere. If this was not you, reset your password immediately and contact support.

layout.whyTransactional: You are getting this email because of a booking or an account action on ETicketsGo.
layout.whyMarketing: You are getting this email because you agreed to hear from ETicketsGo.
layout.whySupport: You are getting this email because you wrote to ETicketsGo support.
layout.whySupportInbox: This is a copy of a message sent to ETicketsGo support through a form.

leads.BOOKING_CONFIRMED: Your booking is confirmed. Here are the details.

campaign.why: You are getting this email because you agreed to hear from {organizer} about {topic}.
campaign.testBanner: This is a test email. It was not sent to your audience.
